facts.fact_text: On 14 April 2010 the applicant notified the police that he planned to organise a demonstration on 17 April 2010.
The demonstration was planned to take place from 2 to 7 p.m. on 17 April 2010.
The demonstration was planned to take place in front of the Venyige Street prison in Budapest.
The purpose of the planned demonstration was to draw attention to the 'situation of political prisoners'.
On 16 April 2010 the head of the Budapest Police Department banned the planned demonstration.
The head of the Budapest Police Department banned the demonstration on the grounds that traffic could not be diverted to alternative routes, pursuant to section 8(1) of the Assembly Act.
